title: Use Case D — Schedule Next Lesson on Completion

fsp-008.description: STATUS_CHANGE COMPLETED → enrollment progress → Find-a-Time → PENDING NEXT_LESSON suggestion with lessonId and studentId

fsp-009.description: 3+ pending lessons → AutoScheduleService called, FindATimeService NOT called, deduplication by eventId, cap at NEXT_LESSON_MAX_SUGGESTIONS

fsp-010.description: preferContinuityInstructor=true → getTrainingSessions called → last instructorId passed as preferredInstructorIds to FindATimeService

fsp-020.description: hourly scan with existing PENDING NEXT_LESSON suggestion → 'duplicate skipped' logged with studentId, scheduleNextLessonForStudent NOT called
